name: Hachures
description: Round patches of close parallel hatching, one to a cell, the hatching turned by a smooth field like the slope strokes an engraver cuts into an old relief map.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { -webkit-clip-path: circle(47% at 50% 50%); clip-path: circle(47% at 50% 50%); :after { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -21%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3.6%, transparent 3.6% 10%); mask: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 3.6%, transparent 3.6% 10%); -webkit-transform: rotate(@rn(-20, 200)deg); transform: rotate(@rn(-20, 200)deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
